reviews.title: Not one discount was successful
reviews.text:
I attempted to use its deals on more than a dozen different products - 4 different dates attempted 3-6 purchases every day. 

I followed the instructions step by step, just as directed. Not once did I successfully receive the advertised discount. Every single attempt was unsuccessful.   
I rarely leave negative online reviews, but I feel other consumers deserve to know about my experience. What’s the point of advertising discounts and promoting an app if the codes don’t work?

Total waste of time.
